tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Find flights between two cities or airports for given dates. Returns airport codes, booking links to compare live fares (Aviasales, Kiwi.com, Skyscanner, Google Flights) and, when available, recently seen cheapest fares. tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Find hotels in a city (optionally near an area or landmark) with addresses and map coordinates, plus booking links prefilled with the dates. Does not show prices — the booking links do.

tools.name: search_transfers
tools.description: Get from A to B on arrival — e.g. airport to hotel. Resolves both ends, gives the straight-line distance, public-transport and driving directions links, and links to pre-book a private transfer.

tools.name: find_things_to_do
tools.description: Top sights, museums, parks, viewpoints and other attractions in a city with coordinates, plus links to book tours and tickets.

tools.name: find_food_spots
tools.description: Restaurants, cafés and bars in a city that people saved from TikTok, Instagram and YouTube food videos on GeoTok — verified places with the dish to order. Great for 'where should I eat in X'.

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Everything for a day-by-day itinerary in one call: hotel options, sights and food spots with coordinates, plus hotel and tour booking links.

tools.name: find_trips_on_budget
tools.description: "I have €500, I'm flying from Madrid, anywhere is fine": finds destinations whose recently seen round-trip fare leaves enough of the budget for the hotel. For each: the fare, the money left per night for a hotel, flight and hotel booking links, and how many verified food spots from TikTok/Instagram

tools.name: save_trip_to_geotok
tools.description: Save a trip (hotel, sights, food spots — any places), plus the chosen flights and hotel bookings, to GeoTok and get a public link; the GeoTok app keeps the trip available offline.
